items.name: core
items.title: Core
items.description: Shared logic, icons, motion patterns, style data, the reset and the base CSS. Every other item needs it.
items.docs: Import ds/ds.css and one ds/style-<id>.css once at the app root. Dialog and Tooltip read process.env.NODE_ENV: in a Vite app add "node" to compilerOptions.types.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Stamps every runtime axis on its own element, resolves what is not passed from the nearest parent Theme, and gives the subtree its direction, icon set and style data.
items.docs: Wrap the app in Theme. Its style prop picks the style; add that style item too.

items.name: style-desk
items.title: Desk style
items.description: Tokens for dark and light, fonts and recipes of the Desk style.
items.docs: Import ds/style-desk.css after ds/ds.css, and set style="desk" on Theme.

items.name: style-liquid
items.title: Liquid style
items.description: Tokens for dark and light, fonts and recipes of the Liquid style. Status: proposed, waiting for the owner.
items.docs: Import ds/style-liquid.css after ds/ds.css, and set style="liquid" on Theme.

items.name: style-neutral
items.title: Neutral style
items.description: Tokens for dark and light, fonts and recipes of the Neutral style. Status: proposed, waiting for the owner.
items.docs: Import ds/style-neutral.css after ds/ds.css, and set style="neutral" on Theme.

items.name: style-studio
items.title: Studio style
items.description: Tokens for dark and light, fonts and recipes of the Studio style.
items.docs: Import ds/style-studio.css after ds/ds.css, and set style="studio" on Theme.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that open and close. Each title is a heading holding the system Button that toggles its section. One or many open at a time.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message about the page or a section that stays until it is fixed or dismissed: a form error summary, a sync problem, a plan limit.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A modal question about an action that cannot be undone. The person must answer it: Cancel or the action. It never closes on a click outside.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: Keeps a box, and the image, video or embed inside it, at a fixed ratio of width to height at any width.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: A text field that suggests as you type, where any text is a valid answer. Suggestions filter in a list under the field; choosing one fills the field, and Enter with nothing highlighted keeps what was typed.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or a workspace shown as an image, initials or an icon, with an optional status dot.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: AvatarGroup
items.description: A few overlapping avatars and a +N count for the rest, named as one group.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small static count or status label attached to something: unread 3, Beta, Draft.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A page wide notice at the top of the app: maintenance, a trial that ends, an outage. A named region the consumer dismisses and remembers.

items.name: bento
items.title: Bento
items.description: A grid of tiles of mixed sizes (1x1, 2x1, 1x2, 2x2) for overviews and landing sections. Reading order is the visual order.

items.name: bidi
items.title: Bidi
items.description: Isolates each Latin run inside Arabic copy, so sentence punctuation stays at the logical end of the line.
items.docs: Bidi ships inside the theme item. Import it from ds/react/theme.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: The path from the top of a site to the current page: links to each level above, then the current page with aria-current page.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action the person takes on this page: save, send, open, delete. The one control that renders a native button.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: A labelled row or column of two to five related actions, spaced apart or attached into one seamed control.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: A static note inside content: a tip, a caution or a fact to keep in mind, read in reading order with the text around it.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered, filled or raised container for one item: optional media, a header with a title and a description, a body, and a footer with actions. The whole card can be one link.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: One on or off choice that is saved with a form, with an indeterminate state for a parent of mixed children.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: CheckboxGroup
items.description: Several Checkbox items under one question, in a fieldset with a legend, with one value array.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact pill you press (a filter, toggled with selected) or remove (a picked value).

items.name: close-button
items.title: CloseButton
items.description: The one close control for dialogs, toasts, banners, chips and drawers: a ghost icon button with the close icon and a default name.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text field that filters a long list as you type and keeps one value from it. The list opens under the field; focus stays in the field while the arrow keys move through the matches.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: A modal search box over the page that finds a command by name and runs it. It opens from anywhere with Mod+K (Command K on a Mac, Control K elsewhere) or from a trigger Button.

items.name: consent-field
items.title: ConsentField
items.description: One consent: a Checkbox or Switch whose label is one purpose, a link to the details, an optional record line, and a record of the choice handed to the app. Never ticked in advance.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: Centers page content at a max width with a gutter on both inline sides.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: The actions of an item, opened on right click, a long press, or Shift+F10 and the Menu key on the focused item. The DropdownMenu surface and parts: items, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators and submenus.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Copies a value to the clipboard and confirms it once: the icon turns to a check and a hidden status says Copied.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Term and value pairs on a dl: the details of an order, a summary of settings, the facts about a record.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal task that must be finished or dismissed. The page behind it is covered by a backdrop, hidden from assistive tech and out of reach until the dialog closes.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A row of app shortcuts at the block end of the screen: Desk's glass dock with a magnify effect, a plain row of icon tiles in other styles.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A full height panel over the page at the inline end or start, for a secondary task such as filters or the details of a selected item. Modal by default; non modal keeps the page usable next to it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a trigger button. Items, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators and submenus, with arrow keys, typeahead and Escape.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: A place with no content yet that says what is missing, what to do next and how, with the action that does it.

items.name: error-state
items.title: ErrorState
items.description: Stands in for a section or a page that failed to load: says what happened, what to do next, and offers a retry, with the error code behind a disclosure.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wires one label, one description and one error message to one form control, and passes the invalid, disabled, read only and required state to it.

items.name: field-error
items.title: FieldError
items.description: An error message under one control or one group: a danger icon and words that say how to fix the value, linked to the control through aria-describedby.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: A group of fields or choices under one legend: a native fieldset, so the legend names the group and native disabled disables everything inside.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: FilterBar
items.description: The row above a list: a search box, quick filter chips, more filters in a menu, the active filter count, clear all, and an end slot for view toggles. One value array holds every filter that is on.

items.name: floating-action-button
items.title: FloatingActionButton
items.description: The one main action of a screen, floating above the content at the inline end and the block end. Icon only or extended with a label.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A native form that checks on submit, lists the errors in a summary with links to the fields, moves focus to the first invalid field, announces the result once and maps server errors to fields by name.

items.name: form-wizard
items.title: FormWizard
items.description: A long form split into steps: a Stepper, one panel per step, back and next, a review step and a submit at the end. Each step is checked before the user moves past it.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Lays out children in columns and rows: a fixed column count, or as many columns as fit at a minimum item size.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: A read only preview card for a link or a person, shown on hover and on keyboard focus of the link. The link works on its own; the card only saves a click.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: One system icon drawn from the icon set of the active style, sized by the size.icon tokens.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A square action button with only an icon. Its label is the accessible name and the text of its Tooltip.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: InlineEdit
items.description: A value shown as text that turns into an Input to edit in place, with save and cancel, such as a board name in its header.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single line text input: a native input in a bordered box with optional start and end adornments.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: An Input joined in one row with add on text and action buttons: a unit, a fixed prefix or suffix, or a Button that acts on the value.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or a keyboard shortcut drawn as keycaps, with the key names spoken to screen readers.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of one control: a native label that focuses or toggles the control on click, with an optional required mark or optional text.

items.name: language-switch
items.title: LanguageSwitch
items.description: Moves the reader to the same page in another language. Two languages render as a link pair, more as a menu. Each language is named in its own language, never with a flag.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A full screen viewer for images, one at a time, with previous, next, zoom, a counter and a caption. Opens from a thumbnail or a Button and returns focus to it.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Navigation to another page, place or site, inside a sentence or on its own line. Always underlined.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A vertical list of rows, each with a title and optional start, description, end and actions. Rows can be links.

items.name: list-box
items.title: ListBox
items.description: A visible list of options to choose one or many from, with groups, descriptions, icons, typeahead and the matched part of each label marked. The same list sits inside the popups of Combobox, Autocomplete, MultiSelect, TagField and CommandPalette.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: The application menu row (File, Edit, View), Desk's menu bar. Menu titles that open DropdownMenu style menus, arrow keys across the row in reading order, and a status slot at the end.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measured value in a known range, such as storage used or a score, with its level in words.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: A closed trigger that opens a list with checks and keeps any number of values from it. The trigger shows the chosen values as tags, or as a count.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The top bar of a site or app: a brand, primary links and menus with panels, actions at the end, and a menu button with a list on phones.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: NotificationCenter
items.description: The panel of notifications: a list grouped by day or by the consumer's groups, unread marks, mark all read, actions per item and an empty state. Placed by the consumer in a Popover or a Sheet.

items.name: number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: A number in a bordered box with a decrement and an increment button, locale formatting with Western digits, units and bounds.

items.name: otpfield
items.title: OTPField
items.description: A one time code shown in separate cells: one native input holds the code, the cells draw it.

items.name: page-shell
items.title: PageShell
items.description: The frame of a page: a skip link first, then a header, the navigation column, one main, an aside and a footer, each in its landmark. Under breakpoint.tablet the navigation moves to a Drawer behind a menu button.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page controls for a long list or table: first, previous, page numbers with ellipses, next and last, with an optional item summary such as 21 to 40 of 312.

items.name: password-field
items.title: PasswordField
items.description: A password input with a show and hide toggle, built on Input, that works with password managers.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: PhoneField
items.description: A phone number with a country code picker, Gulf countries first. The value out is E.164.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Non modal content anchored to a trigger: a small form or details next to the control that opened it. The page stays usable while it is open.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: A labelled bar that shows how far a task has come, or that it runs with no known end.

items.name: progress-circle
items.title: ProgressCircle
items.description: Compact progress in a ring, for a file chip, a card corner or a table cell.

items.name: radio-card
items.title: RadioCard
items.description: One choice among a few options drawn as cards with a title, text, an optional icon and end content such as a price.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: One choice among a few visible options: round controls with labels under a legend, with an optional description and error.

items.name: rail
items.title: Rail
items.description: A narrow column of icon destinations with short labels, a start and an end: the Studio rail.

items.name: range-slider
items.title: RangeSlider
items.description: A low and a high value on one track, such as a price range, with two thumbs that cannot cross.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Pick or show a score from 1 to 5 (or 10) as stars. Interactive it is a radio group of stars; read only it is an image with a label, with half stars.

items.name: resizable-panels
items.title: ResizablePanels
items.description: Two or more panels side by side or stacked, with dividers a person drags or moves with the keys to share the room. Sizes are percents, reported through onLayout for the app to save.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A scroll container with thin styled scrollbars over native scrolling, and edge fades on the side that still has content.

items.name: scrub-input
items.title: ScrubInput
items.description: The Studio inspector number: drag the label to scrub, type a value or an expression such as 12*2, or nudge with the arrow keys.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: A search box: a search icon, a search input, a clear button while there is a query, an optional end slot and a loading state.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A titled region of a page or panel: a heading at a level you set, an optional description and actions, and a body that can collapse.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: One choice among two to five views or modes, always one selected: a track of items with a thumb that slides to the selected one.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A closed trigger that opens a short list and keeps one value from it. The trigger shows the chosen label; the list opens under it and takes focus while it is open.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin line between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional short centered label.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel that rises from the bottom of the screen, for phone layouts and quick tasks. A drag handle closes it, with the close control and Escape as the key path.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The side navigation of an app: groups of links with icons and counts, a header, a footer and a collapsed icon form.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shape that stands where content will appear while it loads: a text line, a circle or a rectangle.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: SkipLink
items.description: The first link of a page. Hidden until it takes keyboard focus, then Enter moves focus past the header and navigation to the main content.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: One number on a range, picked by dragging a thumb or with the arrow keys.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small turning ring that says something is busy and its length is unknown.

items.name: split-button
items.title: SplitButton
items.description: A main action fused to a chevron trigger that opens a menu of related actions. Both halves share one size, tone, emphasis and shape and read as one control.

items.name: split-view
items.title: SplitView
items.description: A list and its detail side by side with a resize handle, stacked one at a time with a back Button under breakpoint.tablet, as in a mail reader.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Lays out children in one direction, a column or a row, with a gap from the space token scale.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One number with its label, its change since the last period and a short hint: a KPI.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: StatusDot
items.description: A small colored dot with the state in words next to it: Online, Sync failed, Syncing.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Shows the steps of a process in order, which are complete, which one is current and which are still to come.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: A plain background box on one surface step (body, surface 1 to 5), with an optional border, elevation, radius and padding.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on or off setting that takes effect the moment it changes.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: TabBar
items.description: The bottom bar of three to five top level destinations on phone layouts: an icon over a label for each, the current one marked.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: TableOfContents
items.description: Links to the headings of a long page, nested by level, with the section in view marked as the reader scrolls.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between panels of related content in place. A labelled list of tabs, one active at a time, with its panel below or beside it.

items.name: tag-field
items.title: TagField
items.description: A box where people type free tags: Enter or a comma adds the text as a tag, each tag has a remove button, and optional suggestions show under the box.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi line text in a bordered box that grows with the text, with an optional character count that never cuts the text.

items.name: tile
items.title: Tile
items.description: The borderless card of Studio: a thumbnail, a title, one meta line and an icon action, laid out in a TileGrid split by a 1px gap that shows the parent surface.

items.name: title-bar
items.title: TitleBar
items.description: The bar at the top of a window or a panel: window controls at the start, the title, then trailing actions.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short notice that something happened, shown in a corner and gone on its own. Called from anywhere with toast(); one Toaster renders them. Call shape: toast(title, options) or toast(options); toast.success, toast.warning, toast.danger and toast.info set the tone; each returns the id; toast.dismiss(id) closes one (or all, without an id), toast.update(id, patch) changes one in place, toast.configure(config) sets the max and the durations for the app.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: ToggleButton
items.description: A button that stays pressed or not: bold, mute, grid view. aria-pressed tells assistive tech the state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A labelled set of toggle buttons with one tab stop, where one (type single) or several (type multiple) can be on: text style, filter chips, view options.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A labelled row of controls for one context, such as a text editor or a canvas. One tab stop, arrow keys between items, and a More tools menu for what does not fit.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint for a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus. The only way to show a hint in the system: never the native title attribute.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A short guided tour that points at real parts of the screen, one step at a time. Not modal: the page stays usable, a ring marks the target and skip is always there.

items.name: window
items.title: Window
items.description: An app window over the page: a title bar, a body and an optional footer. It opens from a trigger, moves, zooms, minimizes and closes. Desk draws it as a glass window with traffic lights; Studio as a flat panel with a close button.

items.name: window-controls
items.title: WindowControls
items.description: The traffic lights of a window: close, minimize and zoom. 12px lights with 24 by 24 px targets, each an IconButton with its own label.
